Samir (oncall): Quick Q — during today's canary we're seeing latency spikes on /generate. Who's allowed to rescind the low-latency toggle if we need to pull it, and what's the minimal audit info we should attach? :eyes:
Maria (eng-platform): Short answer: oncall + eng-platform leads. Also allowed: SRE oncall if they've been cleared in the runbook for that window. The flag name is `feature:low-latency-q2`.
Maria (eng-platform): Ops checklist we usually require: who flipped it, why, time, and a link to the incident/ticket. That's enough to meet audit + postmortem needs.
Jess (eng-sre): Agree. Add a short incident comment and the CLI command we use so it's atomic. Example:```bash
redwood flags set feature:low-latency-q2 off --meta "pulled-by=Samir(oncall);reason=latency spike;ticket=INC-4123"
```
Samir (oncall): Perfect. If I pull it now I can paste that into the ticket. Do we also need an ops-bot entry or will the command populate audit logs?
ops-bot: automated-log: flag-change recorded -> {"flag":"feature:low-latency-q2","action":"off","by":"Samir (oncall)","ts":"1712504321"} :white_check_mark:
Maria (eng-platform): The CLI writes to the flag audit store, but please also create a one-line incident update so it's easy to find in search. Something like: "Pulled feature:low-latency-q2 due to  p99 latency spike on /generate (see logs)."
Samir (oncall): Got it — pasteable line: "Pulled feature:low-latency-q2 at 2024-04-05T15:12Z due to p99 latency spike on /generate; actioned by Samir (oncall)."
Jess (eng-sre): I'll watch during the flag flip and take responsibility for the post-flip smoke tests. If Samir pulls it, I'll run the quick curl checks and confirm.
Samir (oncall): Ok I'm going to flip in 30s. Will post the exact CLI output and incident comment here when done. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: automated-log: preflight-checks passed -> {"hosts_reachable":true,"smoke_tests":"pending"} :gear:
Samir (oncall): (after) CLI returned success. Output: `Flag feature:low-latency-q2 set to off (version 42)`. Posted INC-4123 with Maria's one-liner.
Jess (eng-sre): Confirming basic endpoints are back to expected latency within the canary. I'll update the ticket with the metrics snapshot in 10m. :white_check_mark:
